title: Codex Agent Role / Subagent Format
description: JSON Schema for OpenAI Codex CLI agent role and subagent configuration (TOML format, installed to ~/.codex/agents/ or .codex/agents/)

description.description: Short description of what this agent does and when to use it

developer_instructions.description: System prompt / developer instructions for this agent role

nickname_candidates.description: Alternative names the agent can be referred to as

model.description: Model identifier to use for this agent role

model_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the model

sandbox_mode.description: Filesystem/network sandbox policy: read-only (default), workspace-write, or danger-full-access (no sandbox)

mcp_servers.description: MCP server configurations available to this agent
